'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is an [[anagram clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 11
|text = The anagram reveals<br>who to speak to:<br><br>A BAS
|notes = Speak to [[Saba]]

==Transporation==
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to [[Warriors' Guild]] and run north.
*[[Games necklace]] teleport or the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Burthorpe Games Room]] and run north-west.
*The [[Portal of Heroes]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[Myths' Guild]] teleport to outside the front door of the Heroes' Guild and run north.
